expectedBehavior: A client drives a local config-options agent over stdio in three passes. Passes 1 (builder agent) and 2 (annotated agent) advertise boolean config option support: session/new offers a grouped model select marked as the model picker (Hosted: orbit-1-mini orbit-1 orbit-2-preview; Local: local-7b), a mode select (ask/code) and a boolean verbose option, and also reports legacy modes. Setting model to orbit-1, mode to code and verbose to true each returns the full option list showing the new value. Setting model to gpt-99 is rejected with code -32602. A prompt answers '[orbit-1, mode=code] Hello from the ... agent.' with the verbose explanation, stop reason end_turn. After selecting orbit-2-preview, the next prompt shows a thought that it is rate limited, then a config_option_update from the agent whose model is back to orbit-1, then the answer, stop reason end_turn. Pass 3 (builder agent, no boolean support advertised) offers only model and mode (no verbose), rejects setting verbose with -32602 'Unknown config option', and after a legacy session/set_mode to code the prompt answer shows mode=code. Ends with '=== Demo Complete ===' and no exceptions or stack traces. The -32602 rejections are expected behaviour, not errors.
